comment: The functional checklist of the dentist brief, the same for the HTML and the Nyra version. check.js reads it. Every item is derived from a requirement of the brief; the method section of results/2026-10-19/REPORT.md says how each kind is checked. FAQ answers are checked by the faq item (they may only be in the page once opened).
title: Zelená Dental – gentle dentistry in Olomouc
description: Family dental practice on Horní náměstí in Olomouc: check-ups, hygiene, fillings, whitening and children's dentistry. New patients welcome.

clock.note: a Wednesday morning: the practice is open

text: Gentle dentistry for the whole family
Check-ups, hygiene and modern treatment without the stress. New patients welcome, children from 3 years.
A thorough exam every six months, with digital X-rays only when needed.
Scaling, polishing and airflow cleaning by our hygienist.
Safe in-office or at-home whitening for a brighter smile.
Calm first visits and sealants for kids from 3 years.
Toothache? Call before 10 a.m. and we will see you the same day.
Twenty years of practice and a soft spot for nervous patients.
Fillings, root canals and crowns, done carefully and explained clearly.
Makes cleanings painless and teaches the tricks that keep teeth healthy.
Finds you a time that works and answers every question about insurance.
Prices in CZK. Check-ups are covered by public health insurance.
I used to dread the dentist. Here I actually relax.
They fitted in my son the same morning he broke a tooth.
Clear prices and a hygienist who really knows her job.
Send us your request and we will call you back within one working day to confirm the time.

items.a: Yes. We accept new adult patients and children from 3 years. Book a first check-up with the form above.

items.q: Which insurance companies do you work with?
items.a: All Czech public health insurers, including VZP, ČPZP and OZP.

items.q: What should I bring to my first visit?
items.a: Your insurance card, an ID and a list of any medicines you take.
Usually not. If your gums are sensitive, we use a numbing gel at no extra cost.

items.q: How do I cancel an appointment?
items.a: Call us at least 24 hours ahead so that someone else can take your time.
